title: Combined rerank multiplier tuning
wanted_capability: Empirically tune the combined rerank multiplier against the eval suite — current 1.5× cap is a guess.
notes: Measurement substrate shipped on beta/blackbox-v2: bbox_corpus_core::search::metrics (MRR, recall@k, aggregate report), apply_rerank_with_cap + DEFAULT_COMBINED_CAP, and an operator-probe rerank_cap param on bbox_hybrid_search (clamped [1.0,4.0]). Remaining work to close: run the live sweep — per candidate cap in ~{1.0,1.25,1.5,1.75,2.0,2.5}, run the 30 eval-suite queries (eval/check.rs MANIFEST_SOURCES) through bbox_hybrid_search with rerank_cap set and limit=50 against the populated corpus, aggregate ranked entity_ids vs expected_entity_refs with metrics::aggregate, pick the cap by MRR/recall@10, and bake it into DEFAULT_COMBINED_CAP. Needs a daemon running this build. NOTE: the recall_boost dead-signal bug (rerank.rs ln_1p(1+count) saturation) was fixed in the same batch — sweep results predate-invalid any earlier intuition about the temporal lane.
